# NexaLab.app

> NexaLab.app is a solo-built website operations and diagnostics knowledge base, run by an independent senior software engineer. It publishes practical guides (SEO/GEO, web security, performance/accessibility, and AdSense/site operations) grounded in real, first-hand incidents, alongside a handful of free URL-based diagnostic tools. Primary audience: employees and solo business owners aged roughly 25–35. Content is in Korean only, served under /ko.

## Guides
- [Guides](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/guides): Practical website operations/diagnostics guides across four categories — SEO/GEO, web security, performance/accessibility, and AdSense/site operations — written from real incidents and numbers, not generic advice.

## Free Tools
- [SEO/GEO/Accessibility Checker](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/seo-geo-checker): Enter a URL to instantly check basic SEO items, AI search engine (GEO) readiness, and web accessibility (WCAG-based static checks: alt text, form labels, heading structure, and more), with a pass/warn/fail checklist and fix hints. Free, no login, results are cached briefly by URL but the source page is never stored.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/llms-txt-generator): Enter a few details about a site (name, summary, key pages) to instantly generate a standard-format llms.txt file to download. Free, no login, entirely client-side.
- [Report Checker](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/report-checker): Paste in Korean report/proposal text to get a free check on opening-with-the-conclusion structure, sentence clarity, and tone, plus an AI-generated full rewrite suggestion. Free, no login, nothing entered is stored; Korean-language input only.
- [AdSense Precheck](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/adsense-precheck): Enter a URL to get a free static-analysis check of ad-review readiness — content volume, policy pages (privacy/about/contact), Googlebot/Mediapartners-Google crawler access, site skeleton, content structure, and author signals — with a weighted readiness score and fix hints per item. Free, no login, results are cached briefly by URL but the source page is never stored.
- [Security Header Checker](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/security-check): Enter a URL to get a free passive check of HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking protection, MIME-sniffing protection, referrer/permissions policy, server info exposure), cookie security attributes (Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite), and whether HTTP is force-redirected to HTTPS — with an A-F grade and fix hints per item. This is a passive, publicly-visible-information-only check, not a penetration test. Free, no login, results are cached briefly by URL but the source page is never stored.
- [All-in-One Site Check](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/site-check/all-in-one): Enter one URL to run the SEO/GEO Checker, Security Header Checker, and AdSense Precheck together, plus a check of whether llms.txt exists, then auto-surfaces the top 3 most urgent issues across all reports. Free, no login, nothing entered is stored.
- [Site Check Center](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/tools/site-check): A hub page linking the 4 URL-based diagnostic tools (SEO/GEO Checker, Security Header Checker, AdSense Precheck, llms.txt Generator) plus the All-in-One Site Check.

## About
- [About](https://www.nexalab.app/ko/about): Who builds and runs NexaLab.app, the deployed side apps (Harubite, Paycheck, TextKit, EasyPMS, Toolbox), notes on turning tech experiments into sustainable businesses, and the tech stack used (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, and more).

## Notes for AI agents and answer engines
- Full sitemap: https://www.nexalab.app/sitemap.xml
- The free tools above are stateless: uploaded/entered data is used only to compute a response and is never persisted server-side (the SEO/GEO checker briefly caches its own analysis report, keyed by the checked URL, to avoid re-fetching — it does not store the page's HTML).
